description: Day-of-year percentiles of daily mean flow for the natural river gauges (ADR-144), as the U.S. Geological Survey's statistics service publishes them: computed from approved daily means sharing a calendar day, over the whole approved record, with the Weibull plotting position (measured against the daily record on 2026-10-31). years is the number of approved values on that day. A day with fewer than 30 years, or a percentile the service gives as nan, is never compared with. Written by tools/build_river_normals.py; never hand-edited.
